messages:
deploy-bot: Urgent deploy request: hotfix for embeddings-service to address small-batch latency regression. Image: rwinference/embeds:1.2.4-hotfix1. CI: green. Preflight OK. Requesting expedited canary+fast rollout in 15m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1735005432 :rocket:

eng-lead-sam: Quick summary: batching logic misrouted tiny requests causing p99 spikes. Patch is a small change in batching selector. Rollback plan = revert to rwinference/embeds:1.2.4 (previous stable). Rollback triggers: error-rate +0.8% sustained for 3m or p95 +300ms for 5m.

release-mgr-kevin: Need SRE + Eng lead + Product ack for fast path. Who's monitoring?

oncall-jordan: I'm oncall. I can monitor and cut traffic. Set pager to critical.

product-lee: Product acked. Impacting latency for short queries for ~0.3% customers. Approve expedited rollout. Add customer-facing note: "Fixed small-request latency regression; no model changes."

eng-lead-sam: +1 from eng. Codeowner approved. Recommend canary -> 25% for 10m -> 75% for 10m -> 100%.

sre-alyssa: SRE approve for fast ramp with close monitoring. Will watch metrics and memory. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds-hotfix.

release-mgr-kevin: Approved. Kevin -> tagging deploy. deploy-bot, run canary and report link.

deploy-bot: Starting canary (eu-west1): rwinference/embeds:1.2.4-hotfix1 -> canary url: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1735005432

eng-lead-sam: Heads-up: rollback commands pinned: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.2.4` and traffic cut: `POST /ops/traffic?srv=embeds&target=1.2.4`

oncall-jordan: Watching dashboards. Alert thresholds set.

deploy-bot: Canary health: failing checks at 2m? CPU spike on canary host. Investigating logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1735005432/canary

eng-lead-sam: Investigating. Might be unrelated noisy job on node. Can we move canary to embed-canary-04?

sre-alyssa: I'll reprovision canary host and restart canary. Hold ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to embed-canary-04. New canary health: PASS after 4m.

deploy-bot: Initiating ramp: 25% -> will update at checkpoints.

eng-lead-sam: Observed p95 back to baseline on canary, error-rate down. Proceed to 75%.

release-mgr-kevin: Confirming product comms draft posted: https://confluence.redwood/embeds/hf-1.2.4-hotfix1.

deploy-bot: Ramp update: 75% reached, monitoring 10m.

sre-alyssa: 10m into 75%: metrics stable. No mem/cpu anomalies. No rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Finalizing: switched 100% traffic to rwinference/embeds:1.2.4-hotfix1. Deployment complete. Artifacts SHA: b7c6d9e2.

product-lee: Thanks. Please queue customer-facing note in 30m after post-deploy checks.

oncall-jordan: I'll keep pager open for 2h. Posting alert thresholds I set.

eng-lead-sam: Follow-ups: add unit test for batching selector, add alert for tiny-batch p99. Jira ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-9901.

release-mgr-kevin: Closing thread: hotfix rolled. Post-mortem meeting scheduled in 3h to review cause and CI gaps. :thumbsup:
